patch_list: Lets the patched app run: replaces PairIP's VM startup with harvested vault/handle data, removes the signature check and license dialog, installs the decrypted native libraries and runtime classes, and fixes camera streaming. DroidCam 10.0…
Unlocks DroidCam Pro (HD/4K, no watermark, all options): the license verdict is forced to Pro and renews itself at every silent re-check. Requires 'Disable PairIP protection'. DroidCam 10.0 only.
